Title: [Q][LSJ] Jyhad Entrancement card missing a word?

Messages.Author: Martin Ward
Messages.Body:
I looked in the recently posted Errata section but did not find a listing for
Entrancement. I have a Jyhad version and I want to know if the inferior
ability has errata to it. The text is "(D) Bleed at +1." In an Inquest
magazine that had a listing of card text for VTES, it read "+1 stealth".

So, is it +1 stealth or +1 bleed?

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
mnw...@auracom.com (Martin Ward) writes:




+1 bleed. No stealth. No errata.
This is how both the Jyhad and VtES versions are printed.
Inquest is incorrect.
